method: Pound the garlic and 2 of the chillies into a paste. Add the shrimp paste, palm sugar, fish sauce and lime juice, mixing well.
Bring the stock to a boil. Stir in the paste, then add the shallots, lemongrass and beef. Simmer until the beef is tender.
Turn off the heat. Stir in the remaining chillies and the Thai basil, and serve hot with jasmine rice.
